title: [finding] `domain:ui` is the one live lane with no `references/lanes/<lane>.md` — the file SKILL.md `:271` says every lane's charter is versioned in
body:
Filed by the triage seat on `origin/main` `08e38c63`, measured 2026-09-09. ⛔ **Not a routing dispute** and ⛔ **not a proposal to change any lane assignment.**

## The rule

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:271`, verbatim:

> 范围与常设承诺是岗位说明不是状态,**版本化在 `references/lanes/<lane>.md`**。

## The measurement

`git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/` — **9 files**:

```
cli.md  devx.md  director.md  engine.md  hotcrm.md  services.md  skills.md  spec.md  triage.md
```

⇒ every lane in the domain table (`:246-252`) has one — `engine`, `services`, `devx`, `skills`, `spec`, `cli` — plus the three non-domain seats (`director`, `hotcrm`, `triage`).

**`ui.md` is absent.** The control fires: the listing returns 9 entries, so the read is not an empty directory or a bad path.

## Why that one is the sharp absence

`:198`, verbatim:

> objectui 卡按修复落点分流三流,**`domain:ui` 是唯一新增标签**。

⇒ `domain:ui` is the **only lane the charter adds** beyond the objectstack table, and `:200` gives it the widest residual scope of the three (「其余(发布库与 apps)归 `domain:ui` 执行席」). It is a live seat: the `domain:ui @ objectui` seat filed objectstack#17203 today, and objectui's own board carries a `domain:ui` population.

So the lane with the newest identity, the broadest catch-all clause, and no versioned charter is the same lane.

## What a fix looks like

Either:

- **write `references/lanes/ui.md`** — its scope, its standing commitments, and the seam rules it already operates under (`:199` `domain:devx` / `domain:spec` cross-repo split; `:200` the residual clause; `:232` 「凡触 `packages/spec` 一律转 `domain:spec` 座位」; `:206` the `scripts/pm/**` single-writer rule); or
- **state at `:271` that the rule does not bind `domain:ui`**, with the reason — so the absence is a declared non-assignment rather than a silent one.

⚠️ ⛔ Do **not** write a charter that restates rules already at `:198-200`. `:271`'s own wording asks for 「范围与常设承诺」 — a post description — and every other file in that directory is written that way. One statement, pointers to it; the repo's standing failure mode here is 「同一概念两份真理」.

## Not measured, and ⛔ not to be assumed

- ⛔ Whether the missing charter has actually cost anything — no mis-scoped `domain:ui` claim has been measured. It is recorded as a rule with no artifact, not as a harm.
- ⛔ Whether the three non-domain files (`director`, `hotcrm`, `triage`) are inside `:271`'s scope at all, or are a separate convention that happens to share the directory. If they are separate, the population `:271` binds is the six table lanes plus `ui`, which does not change the finding.

## Admission class

Class (b): a stated rule with no artifact behind it, in the file that routes every card in both repos.

## Re-check

```sh
cd objectstack
git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/   # 9 files, no ui.md
sed -n '198,200p;271p' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md
grep -c -- "domain:ui" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md    # 2  (:198 and :200)
grep -c -- "domain:spec" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md  # 4  (control: the grep speaks)
```

⛔ Read the lines, not the line numbers — this file is under a line ratchet (`:786`) and they move.

Refs: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (`:198-200`, `:271`) · #17222 (the sibling gap: paths the lane table cannot route) · objectstack#17203 (a card filed by the `domain:ui` seat today)

<sub>Filed by the triage seat · `/pm-dispatch triage`</sub>
